'''Yuzan''' is an NPC in [[Port Gunchao]], [[Huanglong]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Talk to Yuzan)
:'''Yuzan:''' I see no point standing guard here all day... We should strike first.
:{{DIcon}} You're quite the fighter, huh?
::'''Yuzan:''' It just gives me a feeling that we'll lose the initiative if we remain here.
:{{DIcon}} Yes.
::'''Yuzan:''' You get the same feeling, right? How can we just stay here without taking further moves?
:'''Yuzan:''' I heard that the [[TD]] over at [[Desorock Highland]] has been causing quite a stir recently...
:'''Yuzan:''' And here I am, stuck at this port, unable to do anything. I feel useless.
:{{DIcon}} Why is that?
:'''Yuzan:''' Oh, it's just that I got hurt during the war last time... Uncle [[Gaoshan]] just transferred me here for recovery.
:'''Yuzan:''' Uncle Gaoshan said I can't return to the front lines until I fully recover... But it's just some minor injury.
:'''Yuzan:''' ...Darn it. I got too excited. I think my wound has reopened...
{{Dialogue End}}
